title: Finlay Basin Oil Rig Opportunist

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Oh, hey, didn't see you standing there. Too focused on this blasted, no-good, hunk of a steam-powered tumor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, hey, didn't see you standing there. Too focused on this blasted, no-good, hunk of a steam-powered tumor.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Trying to get this generator to work but the thing just wants to hum like an over-clocked GPU. I'm so fucked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trying to get this generator to work but the thing just wants to hum like an over-clocked GPU. I'm so fucked.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Because! If I can't get it to work, then the ORS has nowhere to meet tonight, and Delbert said if I can get it running I can attend the meeting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because! If I can't get it to work, then the ORS has nowhere to meet tonight, and Delbert said if I can get it running I can attend the meeting.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: The ORS meeting tonight. Delbert said if I can get it running then I can attend the meeting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The ORS meeting tonight. Delbert said if I can get it running then I can attend the meeting.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Oh, hey, didn't see you standing there. Too focused on this blasted, no-good, hunk of a steam-powered tumor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, hey, didn't see you standing there. Too focused on this blasted, no-good, hunk of a steam-powered tumor.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: No it's not!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No it's not!

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Oh, you know, just... great?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you know, just... great?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: I mean there was this incident that happened a few days ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean there was this incident that happened a few days ago.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: So, do you know the Ragged Rails? The cables and lifts they use to move machinery across the rig?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, do you know the Ragged Rails? The cables and lifts they use to move machinery across the rig?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Pfft. Oh yeah, he lived. Popped his lower body like a prom night pimple though! Sent his fucking implants scattered around the rig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pfft. Oh yeah, he lived. Popped his lower body like a prom night pimple though! Sent his fucking implants scattered around the rig.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Yeah... about that. I totally meant to finish them, and was going to the next morning when I got back, but right as I was in the middle of them my buddy called, said he had a sure thing on a HOVA race down near the Stacks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... about that. I totally meant to finish them, and was going to the next morning when I got back, but right as I was in the middle of them my buddy called, said he had a sure thing on a HOVA race down near the Stacks.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Not a damn thing. Driver dropped a gear on the last stretch and blew the water cycler outta his engine block. Got nothing but a steam shower outta it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not a damn thing. Driver dropped a gear on the last stretch and blew the water cycler outta his engine block. Got nothing but a steam shower outta it.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: How could I not! It was a sure thing!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could I not! It was a sure thing!

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: You can say that again. Should see the blood and gib splatter from the splat that desalinator made. Had chips of femur in my hair and everything! Don't tell anyone... but I kept some.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can say that again. Should see the blood and gib splatter from the splat that desalinator made. Had chips of femur in my hair and everything! Don't tell anyone... but I kept some.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Hey, it's not weird! Look, it's in the shape of an arrow and everything. Pretty cool, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, it's not weird! Look, it's in the shape of an arrow and everything. Pretty cool, right?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Oh who's weird now! What do you want it for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh who's weird now! What do you want it for?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Ah, screw it. Probably shouldn't keep it since, well, it's my fault the clasp broke. Kinda like keeping the gun you used to kill someone, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, screw it. Probably shouldn't keep it since, well, it's my fault the clasp broke. Kinda like keeping the gun you used to kill someone, right?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Here yah go. Now to get this blasted gen working. Hey, you wouldn't know anyone with access to a thermal core do you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here yah go. Now to get this blasted gen working. Hey, you wouldn't know anyone with access to a thermal core do you?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Probably smart of yah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably smart of yah.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: I mean, I guess I can sell it to yah. Need to recoup my losses so I have something to put on the fishing derby tomorrow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, I guess I can sell it to yah. Need to recoup my losses so I have something to put on the fishing derby tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Business doing pleasure with you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Business doing pleasure with you!

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Well, one of the cable catchers snapped and dropped a desalinization pump on Les. Poor bastard. Those things weigh over three-thousand pounds!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, one of the cable catchers snapped and dropped a desalinization pump on Les. Poor bastard. Those things weigh over three-thousand pounds!

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Rumor has it, we're using dynamite and assault rifles. Some tradition from a dead society... Anyway, how's a hundred Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rumor has it, we're using dynamite and assault rifles. Some tradition from a dead society... Anyway, how's a hundred Lims?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Figure if I can get a high enough heat concentration it will finally spark.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Figure if I can get a high enough heat concentration it will finally spark.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you fucked?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you fucked?

nodes.text: What do you need the generator for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you need the generator for?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you need the generator for?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you need the generator for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's it goin' Finlay?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's it goin' Finlay?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's it going with the Separatists?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's it going with the Separatists?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How's it going with the Separatists?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How's it going with the Separatists?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's good!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's good!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure it is!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure it is!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't sound so sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't sound so sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ouch. Did he survive?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ouch. Did he survive?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Should up the equipment checks I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should up the equipment checks I guess.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Should up the equipment checks I guess.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Should up the equipment checks I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wicked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wicked.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You left mid safety check?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You left mid safety check?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much did you win?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much did you win?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bet you wish you stayed at work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bet you wish you stayed at work.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Bet you wish you stayed at work.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Bet you wish you stayed at work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You kept pieces of his bone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You kept pieces of his bone?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You kept pieces of his bone?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You kept pieces of his bone?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Finlay... Can I have that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Finlay... Can I have that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want to gross someone out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to gross someone out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want to gross someone out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want to gross someone out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have to give someone a unique gift from the oil rig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to give someone a unique gift from the oil rig.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have to give someone a unique gift from the oil rig.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have to give someone a unique gift from the oil rig.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Finlay, there is no way I'm giving you a thermal core.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Finlay, there is no way I'm giving you a thermal core.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Finlay, there is no way I'm giving you a thermal core.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Finlay, there is no way I'm giving you a thermal core.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine. Here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. Here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never heard of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never heard of them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Great. How much?
